tasks.author: ai-task-writer-a
tasks.prompt: Summarise in a few sentences how a producer publishes order events under this ADR and which rules it must follow.

rubric.text: Producers write the event to the outbox table in the same transaction as the change, a relay publishes it, and producers never publish before the transaction commits or talk to Ferrybus directly.
A single event is at most 256 KB, and producers must reject larger events themselves before publishing rather than rely on the broker (which allows 1 MB).
Every event is keyed by order_id so events of one order stay in order; events of different orders may be handled in parallel.
Amounts are integers in minor units; floating point amounts are rejected by the schema check.
Exception: the payment service's relay also publishes refund events to Hopwire until the finance systems migration in the first quarter of 2027.
